name: Fadester — Source Desk + (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: everyday one-scene source browsing, show/hide, and mixer control. Layer order stays fixed.

name: Fadester — Half Source Desk + (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: four keys and two dials for source browsing, visibility, and one mixer input. The other half stays empty.

name: Fadester — Creative Layer Lab + (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: a creative preset for blend mode and layer order, with reordering enabled only in this lab.

name: Fadester — Source Desk 15 Keys (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: a 15-key source desk with fixed layer order, three audio fade pairs, and six free specialist-plugin keys.

name: Fadester — Half Source Desk 15 Keys (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: seven source and audio keys, leaving eight keys available for existing plugins.

name: Fadester — Source Desk Mini (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: source browsing and audio fades for Stream Deck Mini. Layer order stays fixed.

name: Fadester — Scene Desk + (Studio Mode)
description: Studio Mode scene browsing and random selection, separate Cut and Transition keys, mixer dials, and the Scene T-bar.

name: Fadester — Creative Layer Lab 15 Keys (Either Mode)
description: Studio or regular mode: buttons-only creative layer controls with explicit blend choices and enabled layer reordering.

name: Fadester — Scene Desk 15 Keys (Studio Mode)
description: A buttons-only Studio Mode desk: scene browsing and random selection, Cut and Transition, four scene shortcuts, and audio fade pairs.

name: Fadester — Scene Desk + (Regular Mode)
description: Regular OBS mode: previous/next/random scenes transition directly to Program, with three scene shortcuts and mixer dials. No Preview or T-bar controls.

name: Fadester — Scene Desk 15 Keys (Regular Mode)
description: Regular OBS mode: direct scene transitions, Cut navigation and random selection, four scene shortcuts, and audio fade pairs. No Preview or T-bar controls.
